Ubenimex (rINN) NK-421; NSC-265489; Ubénimex; Ubenimexum. (−)-N- [(2S,3R)-3-Amino-2-hydroxy-4-phenylbutyryl]-L-leucine. Убенимекс C16H24N2O4 = 308.4. CAS — 58970-76-6. Pharmacopoeias. In Chin. Profile Ubenimex is a peptide derived from Streptomyces olivoreticuli. It is reported to have antineoplastic and immunostimulant prop- erties. It has been used in the adjuvant treatment of acute myeloid leukaemia and is under investigation for the treatment of lung cancer. Adverse effects include gastrointestinal and hepatic func- tion disturbances, skin rashes, headache, and paraesthesias. ◊ References. 1. Ichinose Y, et al.
